name: ORB 5 with flow, taken only when the far side's resting size was pulled before the break
why: Market makers pull their resting orders on the side about to be run over; resting size thinning on the far side in the minutes before an ORB break, with aggressor flow agreeing, means the break is being let through rather than defended. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (test 3).
